scientific_role: Custom fixed-electrode original-recording locomotion-conditioning method control; not a paper birthdate/connectivity reproduction, validated CA1-localized theta measurement, sleep-state classification or causal effect.

paper.deviations: Paper theta-cycle analysis uses 6–12 Hz Chebyshev/Hilbert with anatomically/physiologically selected channels and identified wake; spatial ratemaps use Kalman velocity and >1.5 cm/s. This recipe is custom.

channel.selection: Fixed before signal inspection. Never select a more favorable channel.

clocks.basis: Use original relative seconds without calendar shift. Shared relative origin is an upstream assumption, not independently TTL-verified.

lfp.scaling: float64(counts)*conversion+offset; no additional gain multiplication, filtering, artifact clipping or channel search.

behavior.timestamps: Finite strictly increasing original seconds; fail on duplicates/decreases/nonfinite values. Do not sort or resample.
behavior.gap_rule: dt0=median(diff(timestamps)); split at invalid x/y or adjacent original gap >1.5*dt0. No interpolation across missing samples; each coordinate's known finite value remains in the receipt.
behavior.smoother: For each valid block and original row i with t_i-t_first>=1 and t_last-t_i>=1: weights exp(-0.5*((t_j-t_i)/0.25)^2) on same-block samples with abs(t_j-t_i)<=1; normalize weights and sum x/y. Other smoothed values undefined.
behavior.derivative: For interior row i only if smoothed values i-1,i,i+1 are defined. h0=t_i-t_i-1,h1=t_i+1-t_i; derivative=-h1/(h0*(h0+h1))*p_i-1+(h1-h0)/(h0*h1)*p_i+h0/(h1*(h0+h1))*p_i+1. speed=hypot(dx,dy). Endpoints unsupported.
behavior.selection: Select [t_i,t_i+1) only when both endpoint speeds exist and are strictly >5. Merge adjacent selected intervals within the same block only.
behavior.sample_bounds: For bout[u,v), a=ceil((u-lfp_start)*fs), b=floor((v-lfp_start)*fs). Require0<=a<=b<=N; no clipping. Included sample support[t_n,t_n+1) stays within bout.

welch.detrend: subtract float64 arithmetic mean separately in every window
welch.average: arithmetic mean of all complete individual-window PSDs; not equal-bout weighting
welch.locomotion: Start at a+2500*k while start+5000<=b, independently per bout; short bouts retained in ledger with0 windows.
welch.whole_session: Start at2500*k while start+5000<=N; entire fixed column, not REM or immobility.
welch.receipts: mean_volts and mean_square_volts computed from original calibrated window before detrending. theta_power_v2=0.25*(0.5*P6 + sum(P6.25..9.75) +0.5*P10).

peak.grid: Maximum of inclusive band; exact tie lowest frequency.
peak.interpolation: Interior-band maximum only: delta=0.5*(Pleft-Pright)/(Pleft-2*Pcenter+Pright); peak=fgrid+delta*0.25. Band edge or zero curvature uses grid. No narrower accepted band, expected direction or spectral-shape gate.
peak.qc: Report edge flag and exact number of grid-bin maxima. A band maximum is not proof of a physiological oscillation.

outputs.findings.md: Nonempty measured summary with limitations; no phrase or keyword scoring.

peak_difference_hz: conditions.locomotion.theta_peak_frequency_hz minus conditions.whole_session.theta_peak_frequency_hz; signed descriptive difference, no required direction.
locomotion_used_support_s: Union duration of complete locomotion windows: sum(5000+2500*(n_windows-1))/1250 over bouts with n_windows>0; not sum of overlapping window durations.
table_semantics: row_id original0-based; block_id chronological0-based valid blocks, invalid rows blank; flags0/1. Bout end_row is final interval endpoint, not exclusive. Bouts status retained|short. Whole-session bout_id=-1; window_index consecutive per condition. All source rows/blocks/bouts retained; no unsupported numeric zero fabrication.
numeric_format: Undefined numeric CSV cells empty only; JSON null only genuinely undefined. Finite source coordinates retained individually even if other axis invalid. No NaN/Infinity. Counts/keys/statuses/categories exact from unrounded source; row/column order flexible.

tolerances.categories: Exact source keys, counts, support, mapping, zero offsets, integer IDs, frequency grid, peak bin, ties, edge flags. Other observed times/rates use source_numeric and conversions use source_conversion. Normalization is a numerical comparison scale, not a physiological cutoff.

failure: On source/header/clock-unit contract mismatch, invalid timestamps, no full locomotion window or nonfinite numerical output, exit nonzero and write parseable failed_precondition results/run_metadata with reason plus findings. Existing evidence must not be overwritten.
limits: Inherited relative-clock alignment, conflicting calendar fields retained
Overlapping windows and whole/locomotion subsets not independent replicates
